The graph above shows the curve $y={(\frac{1}{8})}^{x}+c.$ What is the value of $c?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The horizontal asymptote of $y={(\frac{1}{8})}^{x}$ is $y=0.$

The vertical translation $y={(\frac{1}{8})}^{x}+c$ shifts the asymptote to $y=c.$

In the graph above, the horizontal asymptote is $y=2.$ Therefore, $c=2.$
